data.narrative:
MaverickX is a seed-stage climate and energy company founded by Eric Herrera and Jesse Evans that has raised $19M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a sector universe of 9 peers—1 public (Lenz Energy) and 8 private firms including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix—though narrow stage and valuation-tier filters limit direct peer comparability.

Stage-progression methodology applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of seed-to-next-stage advancement, using total capital raised as a baseline proxy. This method yields an implied valuation of $48M. Peer-median analysis was not applicable; while 8 climate and energy peers exist in the broader dataset, none met minimum thresholds (three or more comparables) within same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-tier buckets. A sector-wide median would introduce material noise given the heterogeneity of business models and development timelines in climate tech.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $40M to $55M, centered on $48M. This narrow single-method result introduces meaningful uncertainty: the absence of tight peer anchors means the range relies heavily on stage-based extrapolation rather than market comparables. Key sensitivities include MaverickX's specific technology maturity, capital efficiency relative to peers, and path to next funding round timing. Additional diligence on unit economics and go-to-market readiness would sharpen conviction within this band.
